radish.name: Radish
radish.long_desc:
The radish is the speedster of AllOne Garden — ready to harvest after just **1 day**. Its modest coin value (🪙6) is offset by how quickly you can cycle harvests, stacking XP and inventory fast.

Radishes grow well next to lettuce and carrot, making them a great filler crop in a companion-planned garden.

tips.0: Plant radishes in empty plots while slower crops mature.
tips.1: Pairs well with lettuce and carrot for small companion bonuses.
tips.2: Great for levelling up quickly early in the game.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.short_desc: Reliable 2-day crop with great companion synergy.
carrot.long_desc:
Carrots are among the most versatile crops in AllOne Garden. They ripen in **2 days** and play nicely with nearly every other plant — benefiting from tomatoes, lettuce, and radishes nearby.

At 🪙10 per harvest they are a solid mid-game earner.

tips.0: Surround carrots with tomatoes (+20%) and lettuce (+15%) for the biggest bonus.
tips.1: Keep away from corn — no synergy there.
tips.2: Good choice for the Compost Heap strategy due to reliable 2-day cycles.

lettuce.name: Lettuce
lettuce.short_desc: Cheap filler crop. Good companion to most plants.
lettuce.long_desc:
Lettuce matures in **2 days** for a modest 🪙8. Its real value is as a companion: it benefits neighbours such as carrots and radishes while itself being boosted by carrot proximity.

Avoid planting next to corn — they antagonise each other (−15% for lettuce).

tips.0: Lettuce is cheap insurance: fill gaps between high-value crops.
tips.2: Never plant next to corn if you care about yield.

sunflower.name: Sunflower
sunflower.short_desc: Bright 2-day crop. The best friend of pumpkins.
sunflower.long_desc:
Sunflowers are the companion kings of the garden. They ripen in **2 days** for 🪙12 and provide a +15% bonus to adjacent pumpkins — making them essential in any late-game pumpkin setup.

They also benefit from blueberry neighbours (+10%).

tips.0: Always surround pumpkin plots with sunflowers.
tips.1: Sunflower + Blueberry + Pumpkin is a powerful late-game trio.
tips.2: Short growth cycle means you can harvest 2–3 times per pumpkin cycle.

tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.short_desc: Classic 3-day crop. Great earnings with the right neighbours.
tomato.long_desc:
Tomatoes take **3 days** but pay 🪙15 at harvest. Combined with a 20% carrot companion bonus the effective value rises to 🪙18 — among the best mid-game returns.

Keep them away from pumpkins, which reduce tomato yield by 10%.

tips.0: Tomato + Carrot is one of the strongest early-game duos (+20%).
tips.1: Add a lettuce border for a small extra boost.
tips.2: Water every day — tomatoes punish neglected plots.

potato.name: Potato
potato.short_desc: Hearty 3-day crop. Loves corn, hates pumpkins.
potato.long_desc: Potatoes take **3 days** and earn 🪙12. Their standout feature is a strong synergy with corn: potatoes next to corn earn a +20% bonus (and corn next to potatoes does too), making the Corn/Potato pair one of the most efficient arrangements in the game.

tips.0: Alternate rows of corn and potato for a mutual +20% bonus.
tips.2: The Greenhouse protects high-value corn/potato plots from storm damage.

blueberry.name: Blueberry
blueberry.short_desc: High-value 4-day crop. Pairs beautifully with sunflowers.
blueberry.long_desc:
Blueberries take **4 days** to mature but reward patience with 🪙22 at harvest. They benefit from sunflower and carrot neighbours, fitting neatly into a mixed garden.

Because of the longer cycle, fertilize every blueberry plot to accelerate growth.

tips.0: Always fertilize blueberries — shaving off even 0.5 days matters over many harvests.
tips.2: Use the Well early in a blueberry cycle to water everything in one go.

corn.name: Corn
corn.short_desc: Tall 4-day crop. Best friend of potato, worst enemy of pumpkin.
corn.long_desc:
Corn ripens in **4 days** for 🪙18. The mutual Corn/Potato bond (+20% each) makes this pair the backbone of a productivity-focused garden.

Corn actively harms lettuce (−15%) and pumpkins (−20%), so careful plot planning is essential.

tips.0: Alternate corn and potato columns for maximum mutual bonus.
tips.1: Keep corn far from lettuce and pumpkin plots.
tips.2: Fertilize corn to bring the 4-day cycle down effectively.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.short_desc: The most valuable crop. Slow but worth the wait.
pumpkin.long_desc:
Pumpkins take a full **5 days** to ripen but pay out 🪙28 — the highest base value in the game. Add a sunflower companion bonus (+15%) and the effective yield climbs to 🪙32.

Pumpkins are fragile: corn, potato, and tomato neighbours all reduce yield. Plan the pumpkin block of your garden carefully.

tips.0: Surround every pumpkin with sunflowers — a +15% bonus on 🪙28 adds up fast.
tips.1: Build the Greenhouse before planting pumpkins: storms can knock ripe crops back a day.
tips.2: Fertilize + water every cycle. Never skip a day on pumpkins.
tips.3: Keep pumpkins in a dedicated corner, away from corn and potato.

well.name: Water Well
well.short_desc: Waters all tilled plots in one click. 3 charges per day.
well.long_desc:
The Water Well costs **50 🪙** to build and gives you 3 charges every day (replenished at each Next Day tick). Each use raises the water level of every tilled plot by +2.

Indispensable once your garden exceeds 10–12 active plots — the time saved clicking individual plots is enormous.

tips.0: Build the Well as your second structure (after Compost Heap).
tips.1: Charges reset every Next Day — never save them; use all 3 each day.
tips.2: Combine with fertilizer for maximum daily growth per plot.

compost_heap.name: Compost Heap
compost_heap.long_desc:
The Compost Heap costs **30 🪙** and pays for itself within a few harvests. After every 3 harvests it generates 1 fertilizer charge. Clicking "Fertilize All" applies that charge to every planted, unfertilized plot instantly.

The cheapest structure and the first one you should build.

tips.0: Build this first — 30 🪙 is achievable within your first 5–10 harvests.
tips.1: Save the charge for when you have many planted plots.
tips.2: Fertilizer + water on the same day = fastest possible growth.

greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
greenhouse.short_desc: Passive shield against storm and drought damage.
greenhouse.long_desc:
The Greenhouse costs **80 🪙** and works passively — no charges, no clicks. It converts storm ⛈️ and drought 🏜️ weather events into safe Cloudy conditions, preventing all crop damage and reducing drought-pest chance from 15% back to 5%.

Essential before committing to a full 24-plot pumpkin or blueberry garden.

tips.0: Build the Greenhouse before planting your first pumpkins.
tips.1: Storms can knock a ripe pumpkin back by a whole day — the Greenhouse prevents this.
tips.2: Once built, you never need to worry about weather again.
